scientific_integrity: Original exact kernel/null spectrum attributed to Hwang and Kuriki; earlier order-two theory attributed to Henze and Nikitin. The new claim is a proved triangular-array limit with reproducibility checks; no independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Fixed order and amplitude, positive integer increasing frequencies, known circular uniform null; no growing-order, truncated-family, estimated-parameter, general-frequency or minimax claim. Historical priority risk disclosed in REVIEW.md.
title: Sharp moving-frequency blindness and spectral separation of generalized Watson tests
